title: verification-gate per-repo config (harmonic-forge#708)
description: The commands a repo's verification gate runs before any committing restart. The platform owns the procedure; each repo owns its commands.

policy_doc.description: Repo-relative path to the repo's own gate policy (coverage overrides, proof-path rules). Read in full before running the gate.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the repo root. Load-bearing: some tools discover their config only from the right cwd.

when_changed.description: Run only when one of these repo-relative paths changed. Absent means always.

note.description: Why this command is shaped the way it is. Printed with the command.
